subject: Exec approval: Helix Labs dedicated hardware preference & temporary overage waiver
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marco Gallo <marco.gallo@helixlabs.com>
Cc: purchasing@helixlabs.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 08:12:33 -0700
Subject: Exec approval needed: Helix Labs dedicated hardware preference & temporary overage waiver

Hi Lauren / Aditya / Marco,

Helix sent a firm request this morning asking to lock a Dedicated reservation with a non-standard hardware preference and an initial overage waiver window. Key asks from Helix: 
- Dedicated reservation: 40 GPUs, prefer H100v2 family for training latency profile.
- Committed discount: they are asking for a 60% committed discount on reserved units (term: 12 months).
- Burst allowance: enable a 1.5x burst band for the first 90 days after go-live and waive overage surcharges during that period.

Why this matters: Helix is a strategic Gen-AI customer (pilot now, planned expansion). They will sign Dedicated with an early-commit SOW if we can meet hardware preference and the temporary overage waiver. Without the H100v2 preference they may walk to a competitor that guarantees that SKU.

Asks for this thread: 
1) Exec sign-off on a non-standard SKU preference (H100v2) for the reservation.
2) Approve a temporary overage waiver for the first 90 days (no per-token overage surcharge).
3) Guidance on committed discount: they requested 60% — requesting approval to offer a blended 45-55% discount range depending on confirmed quantity and billing schedule.

Attachments: pricing_matrix.xlsx (pricing scenarios), helix_sow_draft.docx (customer SOW draft). I also attached an initial utilization forecast from the customer below; Aditya, please attach capacity report if available.

Next steps: Lauren, can you confirm whether we can approve the hardware preference + waiver as an exec exception? If so, I will push to Legal for an addendum and to Finance for ARR treatment.

Thanks,
Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Gallo <marco.gallo@helixlabs.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 11:02:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval needed: Helix Labs dedicated hardware preference & temporary overage waiver

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear ask. Two quick clarifying questions before I sign off:
1) What is the dollar delta vs. our standard H100x SKU if we allow H100v2 for the full 40 GPUs? Put another way — what revenue impact does H100v2 preference have relative to the baseline?
2) Is Helix willing to accept an initial partial allocation (e.g., 20 H100v2 + 20 H100x) with guaranteed migration to more H100v2 units as utilization proves out?

I think the waiver duration is the main negotiable item — 90 days is long, but I want to see the capacity report before committing to full waiver. Can Aditya paste the capacity delta and a recommended compromise (waiver length, credit level) in his reply?

If the numbers look reasonable, I can approve a one-time exec exception for hardware preference with a maximum financial exposure and a 60-day overage waiver instead of 90. We should also require Helix to pre-pay month 1 as a sign-of-good-faith.

-Lauren
--
Lauren Bishop
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Gallo <marco.gallo@helixlabs.com>, purchasing@helixlabs.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 14:38:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval needed: Helix Labs dedicated hardware preference & temporary overage waiver

Adding capacity / ops context:

Summary: We have constrained availability for full H100v2 pools in us-west for May-July. Approving H100v2 for all 40 units immediately will add sourcing risk and likely delay provisioning by 3-5 weeks. Suggested operational compromise:
- APPROVE: Up to 20 dedicated H100v2 units in the customer pool guaranteed at go-live.
- FALLBACK: Remaining 20 units to be provisioned on H100x (our baseline SKU) with automatic migration path to H100v2 when capacity frees up. Migration can be scheduled in two waves (month 2 and month 4).
- BURST & WAIVER: Approve a temporary burst band (1.5x) for first 60 days (not 90). We recommend waiving per-token overage surcharges for 60 days only. After 60 days, standard overage rates apply; however we can grant a one-time bill credit equal to 20% of estimated overage for months 2-3 as a retention concession if utilization stays within projected thresholds.

Estimated financials (see pricing_matrix.xlsx attached):
- Baseline (40 H100x): ARR baseline = $2,100,000/year
- Full H100v2 (40 units): ARR delta +24%
- Mixed (20 H100v2 + 20 H100x): ARR delta +11% (relative to baseline)

Recommended commercial approval:
1) Offer the customer the mixed hardware (20 H100v2 guaranteed + 20 H100x with migration windows).
2) Commit to a 45% reserved discount on the mixed-plan (compromise from their 60% ask).
3) Approve a 60-day overage waiver + a conditional bill credit framework for months 2-3 (subject to utilization thresholds).

Attachments: capacity_report_q2.pdf (pool availability), pricing_matrix.xlsx (scenarios).

If Legal signals this is workable, I support Lauren sign-off on the compromise.

-Aditya
--
Aditya Rao
Director, Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marco Gallo <marco.gallo@helixlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval needed: Helix Labs dedicated hardware preference & temporary overage waiver

Karthik / Aditya / Marco —

I reviewed the numbers and Aditya's operational constraints. Executive decision: APPROVED with conditions.

Conditions (please include in SOW/addendum):
1) Hardware mix: 20 H100v2 reserved + 20 H100x reserved with explicit migration windows (month 2 and month 4).
2) Discount: approve a 45% reserved discount on the mixed plan (final pricing to be documented in the pricing_matrix.xlsx).
3) Burst & waiver: approve a 1.5x burst band on day 1 with a per-token overage waiver for the first 60 days only. After 60 days standard overage rates apply.
4) Credit: a one-time retention credit equal to 20% of actual overage billed in months 2-3 IF utilization thresholds in the attached forecast are met.
5) Finance requirement: Helix must provide month-1 prepayment and standard credit-check paperwork.

Karthik — proceed to Legal to draft the addendum and lock in DocuSign. Marco — confirm acceptance of these conditions today if possible so we can get procurement moving.

Approving this gets us a strategic Dedicated customer without open-ended financial exposure. Thanks all.

-Lauren
--
